title: Stitch
tagline: Decentralized streaming platform that gives ownership to creators at the time that rewards the fans for their attention and donations.
description:
Each time a donation is sent to an streamer, a fraction of it goes to a Fan Pool. This fan pool is raffled on monthly basis between the most loyal fans. 
As a fan, you receive tickets in proportion of your donation, but we also want to reward your attention during the time you spent watching the content, thats why the streaming videos will have a limited amount of easter eggs hidden for you to find and claim. These easter eggs will give the holder a chance to participate in the raffle even if they had never donated before.

We also know there might be an special video streaming for you, maybe could be when your streamer won the champioship of your favorite game, a funny one when doing something silly, or even the one when the creator called your name. This is why you will be able to purchase an NFT of the video and own that special content for life.
how_its_made:
To make all this possible, Stitch is powerded by some of the most innovative protocols in web3. Using Wallet Connect, users will be able to connect to Polygon network to interact with the platform. For a fair Fan Pool Raffle, Stitch will integrate with Chainlink VRF v2 adding a secure and decentralized source of randomness. Integrations will also include The Graph for displaying interest analytics for each profile. On the content side, LivePeer will be our source of streaming. All these technologies will provide a reliable infrastructure for Stitch to work. However, we know this platform will only be as strong as the community that represents, and the personal network each users brings, thats why we have also added a Lens integration is our roadmap.
